Engine_Belt.note: fan belt (crank, fan, dynamo): broken = hide it (CHG lamp on, the fan stops: overheating), loose = squeal and a weak charge

Engine_Fan.note: cooling fan: turns with the engine (1500 rpm x 1.2), negative about +x - it blows through the radiator towards the louvre

Radiator_Cap.note: pressure cap: 90 = first stop (hot: steam hisses out), push down and turn on to 180, then it lifts off

Radiator_Drain.note: radiator drain cock (south side, low, beside the upright): unscrew (+) to open, coolant runs out (VFX_RadDrain)

Engine_AirFilterLid.note: air filter lid: undo the wing nut (+), then lift off

Engine_StopLever.note: manual stop on the injection pump: pull the red knob back (+40) and hold until the engine dies; springs back

Engine_GovernorLever.note: governor speed lever, locked at 1500 rpm: frequency = 50 + angle / 6 Hz (needs a spanner to move)

Engine_FuelFilter.note: spin-on fuel filter: unscrew (+, two turns, from below), then it comes off; FuelFilter_Spare goes on in its place (Slot_FuelFilter); clogged = the engine starves and dies

Engine_BleedScrew.note: bleed screw on the filter head: open a turn or two (+), pump Engine_PrimerLever until fuel comes out without bubbles (VFX_FuelBleed), close it; needed after the tank ran dry

Engine_PrimerLever.note: hand primer on the lift pump: pump it (0..35 and back) to push fuel through for bleeding

Engine_WaterDrain.note: drain tap under the water separator bowl: open (+) until the water layer has run out, then diesel

Engine_Dipstick.note: pull out by the yellow ring (+0.42): oil level marks on the stick (texture), wipe, push back

Engine_OilCap.note: oil filler on the rocker cover: quarter turn (+), lift off; Pour_Oil

Battery.note: 12 V 60 Ah starting battery, the same size and post layout as the van's Battery (they swap); lift by the strap with both clamps off

Battery_ClampPos.note: loosen the bolt, lift off the post (minus first); the cable runs under the skid to the starter

Battery_ClampNeg.note: loosen the bolt, lift off the post (minus first); the cable runs under the skid to the starter

Gen_Breaker.note: alternator main breaker on the terminal box (63 A): up = output to the board; trips to the middle on overload

Genset_Plates.note: start instructions under the panel, alternator nameplate

GPanel_Face.note: control panel face (panel atlas): gauges and labels

Needle_Oil.note: gauge needle: the axis points into the panel, + = clockwise for the viewer; rest = the modelled angle from 12 o'clock; angle(value) from scale (linear), turn by angle - rest

Needle_Temp.note: gauge needle: the axis points into the panel, + = clockwise for the viewer; rest = the modelled angle from 12 o'clock; angle(value) from scale (linear), turn by angle - rest

Needle_Batt.note: gauge needle: the axis points into the panel, + = clockwise for the viewer; rest = the modelled angle from 12 o'clock; angle(value) from scale (linear), turn by angle - rest

Needle_GenV.note: gauge needle: the axis points into the panel, + = clockwise for the viewer; rest = the modelled angle from 12 o'clock; angle(value) from scale (linear), turn by angle - rest

Needle_GenA.note: gauge needle: the axis points into the panel, + = clockwise for the viewer; rest = the modelled angle from 12 o'clock; angle(value) from scale (linear), turn by angle - rest

Needle_GenHz.note: gauge needle: the axis points into the panel, + = clockwise for the viewer; rest = the modelled angle from 12 o'clock; angle(value) from scale (linear), turn by angle - rest

GLamp_GLOW.note: amber: glow plugs heating (GLOW button held / key at START)

GLamp_CHG.note: red: no charge from the dynamo (key ON, engine stopped, or the belt broken)

GLamp_OIL.note: red: low oil pressure (key ON, engine stopped, or out of oil: stop it!)

GLamp_TEMP.note: red: coolant too hot (louvre shut, belt broken, no coolant)

GLamp_RUN.note: green: running and the voltage is up

Gen_VAdj.note: voltage trim: + (clockwise) raises the output voltage, 400 V + angle x 0.3 V

Gen_Key.note: key switch: ON (52) powers the panel; START (95, springs back to ON) cranks; pulled out at OFF

Gen_GlowButton.note: GLOW: hold 20 s before starting in the cold (GLamp_GLOW on); springs back

Gen_StopButton.note: STOP: electric fuel cut-off while held; springs back

Gen_EStop.note: emergency stop: push in (latches, the engine stops at once); twist clockwise to release (back to 0)

Genset.note: diesel generating set on its skid: engine, alternator, radiator, panel (one mesh); moving parts are children

Needle_BoardV.note: gauge needle: the axis points into the panel, + = clockwise for the viewer; rest = the modelled angle from 12 o'clock; angle(value) from scale (linear), turn by angle - rest

Needle_BoardA.note: gauge needle: the axis points into the panel, + = clockwise for the viewer; rest = the modelled angle from 12 o'clock; angle(value) from scale (linear), turn by angle - rest

Needle_BoardHz.note: gauge needle: the axis points into the panel, + = clockwise for the viewer; rest = the modelled angle from 12 o'clock; angle(value) from scale (linear), turn by angle - rest

BLamp_LINE.note: white: grid voltage on the LINE drop

BLamp_GEN.note: green: the set is running and Gen_Breaker is on

BLamp_OVERLOAD.note: red: more than 63 A drawn (too many circuits at once): a breaker trips

Board_Changeover.note: changeover switch: the handle points at LINE (-60), OFF (0) or GEN (+60); + = clockwise seen from the room

Board_Brk_Gen.note: GEN main breaker (63 A): up = the set feeds the busbar (with GEN selected)

Board_Brk_Line.note: LINE main breaker (63 A): up = the grid feeds the busbar (with LINE selected)

Board_MCB_1.note: circuit breaker 1: HALL LIGHTS (up = on); trips on overload

Board_MCB_2.note: circuit breaker 2: OUTDOOR LIGHTS (up = on); trips on overload

Board_MCB_3.note: circuit breaker 3: HEATING (up = on); trips on overload

Board_MCB_4.note: circuit breaker 4: RADIO / MAST (up = on); trips on overload

Board_MCB_5.note: circuit breaker 5: SERVER ROOM (up = on); trips on overload

Board_MCB_6.note: circuit breaker 6: WORKSHOP (up = on); trips on overload

Board_MCB_7.note: circuit breaker 7: WATER PUMP (up = on); trips on overload

Board_MCB_8.note: circuit breaker 8: CONTAINER (up = on); trips on overload

Board_Door.note: switchboard door: unlock Board_Latch (90), swings into the room on its west hinges

Board_Latch.note: quarter-turn latch: + (clockwise seen from the room) to 90 opens the door

Board_Door_Signs.note: DANGER sign outside, the circuit card inside the door

Switchboard.note: main switchboard cabinet on the south wall

DayTank_Cap.note: filler cap of the day tank: unscrew (+, one and a half turns), then it comes off

DayTank_Level.note: diesel column in the sight glass: scale along +z = tank fraction (1 = modelled full); the scale reads F .. E

DayTank_Decals.note: level scale, DIESEL DAY TANK stencil, DIESEL ONLY

DayTank_Valve.note: fuel supply ball valve: + (clockwise seen from the room) turns the red lever down along the pipe = open; shut = no fuel to the engine

DayTank_Drain.note: drain cock under the tank: + opens (water and sludge first, VFX_TankDrain)

DayTank.note: 100 l day tank, gravity feed to the engine through DayTank_Valve; the level shows in the sight glass

Drum_1_Vent.note: 3/4" vent bung: open it when pumping so the drum breathes

Drum_2_Bung.note: 2" bung: needs the BungWrench, three turns (+), then it comes out

Drum_2_Vent.note: 3/4" vent bung: open it when pumping so the drum breathes

Drum_3_Bung.note: 2" bung: needs the BungWrench, three turns (+), then it comes out

Drum_3_Vent.note: 3/4" vent bung: open it when pumping so the drum breathes

Drum_1.note: 200 l drum, WINTER diesel (blue): the one that works in the cold; its 2" bung is out - the DrumPump lives here

Drum_2.note: 200 l drum, SUMMER diesel (blue): waxes below about -10 C - it clogs the filter if used (story trap)

Drum_3.note: 200 l drum, PETROL (red): for the van, never for the genset

Pallet.note: spill pallet under the two diesel drums (grid deck)

DrumPump.note: rotary drum pump: stands in a 2" bung hole (Slot_DrumPump_N), suction tube down to the bottom; crank to pump; the coiled hose goes with it (draw a rope from DrumPump_Hose_Start to the nozzle when it is taken off the coil)

DrumPump_Crank.note: crank either way: about 0.3 l per turn

DrumPump_Nozzle.note: hose nozzle: into Pour_DayTank (or a jerrycan), then crank

Shelf.note: wooden shelf on the west wall north of the door

EngineOil.note: 5 l engine oil can: tip into Pour_Oil

EngineOil_Cap.note: screw cap of the oil can

Coolant_Cap.note: screw cap of the coolant jug

FuelFilter_Spare.note: spare fuel filter in its box: replaces the clogged one (waxed summer diesel)

Funnel.note: steel funnel (stands on its rim): goes into any filler

JumperCables.note: jumper cables (red +, black -), 3 m: the van battery to the genset battery when it is flat (ropes between the clamp ends)

BungWrench.note: drum bung wrench: opens Drum_N_Bung and Drum_N_Vent

Extinguisher.note: 6 kg powder extinguisher on its wall bracket: squeeze the lever (VFX_Extinguisher at the hose end)

Mat.note: rubber insulating mat in front of the switchboard

Logbook.note: generator log on a clipboard (hangs on a nail): the last entries

Door_R_Bar_1.note: locking bar: lift the handle out of its catch and swing it out (+, up to 90): the cams at both ends turn out of the keepers on the sill and the header; all of a leaf's bars out = the leaf is free

Door_R_Bar_2.note: locking bar: lift the handle out of its catch and swing it out (+, up to 90): the cams at both ends turn out of the keepers on the sill and the header; all of a leaf's bars out = the leaf is free

Door_R.note: active leaf: Padlock off, both bars turned out (Door_R_Bar_1, _2), Door_Bolt drawn inside; swings out and folds back against the south wall (240)

Door_L_Bar_1.note: locking bar: lift the handle out of its catch and swing it out (+, up to 90): the cams at both ends turn out of the keepers on the sill and the header; all of a leaf's bars out = the leaf is free

Door_L_Bar_2.note: locking bar: lift the handle out of its catch and swing it out (+, up to 90): the cams at both ends turn out of the keepers on the sill and the header; all of a leaf's bars out = the leaf is free

Door_L.note: passive leaf: opens after Door_R, both its bars turned out; stops against the welded doors of the north box (160)

Padlock.note: brass padlock through the catch of Door_R_Bar_2: while it is on, that handle cannot leave its catch; Door_Key opens it, then it lifts off

Door_Bolt.note: barrel bolt on the planks inside the active leaf: shoot it (+0.06) into the keeper on Door_L to lock the doors from inside (the locking bars are outside: shut from outside = locked in)

Door_Key.note: padlock key on a hook on the south side wall by the door end, outside (find it with a torch)

Window_Shutter.note: inside board shutter: 0 = folded open on the wall east of the window, 180 = over the window; Window_Latch holds it shut

Window_Latch.note: turn-button on the wall west of the window: 90 = across the closed shutter edge (+ = clockwise seen from the room)

Louvre_Blade_1.note: radiator outlet louvre blade: follows Louvre_Lever 1:1 (linkage hidden in the frame)

Louvre_Blade_2.note: radiator outlet louvre blade: follows Louvre_Lever 1:1 (linkage hidden in the frame)

Louvre_Blade_3.note: radiator outlet louvre blade: follows Louvre_Lever 1:1 (linkage hidden in the frame)

Louvre_Blade_4.note: radiator outlet louvre blade: follows Louvre_Lever 1:1 (linkage hidden in the frame)

Louvre_Blade_6.note: radiator outlet louvre blade: follows Louvre_Lever 1:1 (linkage hidden in the frame)

Louvre_Lever.note: louvre operator: pull the handle towards the room (0 shut .. 75 open); the six blades follow; running with it shut overheats the engine (TEMP lamp)

Exhaust_Flap.note: rain flap on the stack: the exhaust lifts it while the engine runs (flutter 20..60 with the beat), drops shut when it stops

Light_Switch.note: container lights (three bulkheads) on the CONTAINER circuit (Board_MCB_8): up = on (+50)

Lens_Bulk_Genset.note: frosted dome of a caged bulkhead (lights up with LIGHT_Bulk_Genset)

Lens_Bulk_Ceiling.note: frosted dome of a caged bulkhead (lights up with LIGHT_Bulk_Ceiling)

Lens_Bulk_Board.note: frosted dome of a caged bulkhead (lights up with LIGHT_Bulk_Board)

Lens_Ext_Door.note: bulb under the barn-light shade over the doors

Cont_Signs.note: STROMERZEUGER / GENERATOR plate on the south wall; inside: the louvre and no-flames signs (panel atlas)

Door_R_Sign.note: STROMERZEUGER / GENERATOR on the active leaf

Door_L_Sign.note: VORSICHT 400 V / DANGER 400 V and ZUTRITT VERBOTEN / NO ENTRY on the passive leaf

Snow_Roof.note: snow on the two roofs: blend shape Clear (100 = no snow: the mesh sinks onto the roof, hide the renderer there); thin round the stack, slides off in chunks (VFX) when the exhaust warms it

Snow_DoorDrift.note: drift against the doors outside (both boxes): blend shape Clear (100 = dug out, the mesh sinks under the ground: hide it); the leaves (bottom edge 0.275 m up) clear it only from Clear 64, below that they jam - dig with the van's shovel

GenContainer.note: the twin container (castings, posts, rails, corrugated walls, roofs, the welded doors of the north box, pads, step, mast, stack); prefab root

GenContainer_In.note: inside of the container, finished as the generator shed: ply lining, concrete floor, spruce joists and blocking under the roof's underside, chequer covers, the window, conduits, lamps

Audio_Fan.note: fan roar and the belt (squeal when loose)

VFX_RadSteam.note: steam out of the neck when the hot cap is opened / the engine boils over

Heat_Silencer.note: hot silencer: burns, warms hands, melts snow

Slot_FuelFilter.note: filter head: a spin-on filter screws on here

VFX_FuelBleed.note: froth, then clear diesel dribbles out while bleeding

Pour_Oil.note: engine oil goes in here (cap off)

meta.frame: container frame: x east (the radiator louvre end), y north, z up; ground z = 0 under the pads, floor z = 0.31; origin = the middle of the twin footprint
meta.unity: position (x, y, z) -> Unity (-y, z, x); axis likewise; angle -> -angle (Unity is left-handed); box centre likewise, box size (sx, sy, sz) -> (sy, sz, sx)
meta.colliders: colliders: BoxCollider per entry on its parent (centre / size in the parent frame); part.box: the grab / hit box of a moving part in its own frame
meta.links: links.from / ratio: the part follows another part
